title: Batman Annual #13 DC 1989 George Pratt Cover James Owsley Gray Morrow Who's Who
condition_description: Crease running across the left side of the front cover through the cover-credit strip; light spine wear; back cover toned. See photos.
description:
Batman Annual #13 (1989), DC Comics. Stories by James Owsley, art by Michael Bair and Gray Morrow; Secrets of the DC Universe by Kevin Dooley and Malcolm Jones III; plus new Who's Who entries. Painted cover by George Pratt. $1.75 cover price.

Back cover: TSR Advanced Dungeons & Dragons 2nd Edition Player's Handbook ad.

Condition: a crease runs across the left side of the front cover through the cover-credit strip; light spine wear; back cover toned (see photos, including angled shots).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
